hook_text: It took hundreds of years to make this soil. One storm can wash it away.
clip_script: Matatiele, Eastern Cape. A hillside slashed by dongas, deeper than a grown-up is tall. What happened? Too many cattle, grass eaten to the ground, bare soil. Rain hits, water rushes, soil goes. That is erosion. Now the fix: plant grass, roots hold the soil. Stone walls slow the water. Move the cattle. Plough across the slope, not down it. Slowly, the hillside heals.
visual_style: Whiteboard hillside with a donga, then grass, stone walls and contour lines appearing across it.
mood: Serious at first, then hopeful and proud.
pacing: The damage, the cause, then step-by-step repair.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look for bare soil you could help protect.
